[EN] Not FDA-Approved
[ES] No aprobado por la FDA
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm sure he's nearby."
[ES] "Estoy seguro de que está cerca."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Talk to Dougal.
[ES] Habla con Dougal.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "She could stand to relax a bit..."
[ES] "Podría relajarse un poco..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay, but this is the last time."
[ES] "De acuerdo, pero esta es la última vez."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Maybe you should just leave her be."
[ES] "Tal vez deberías dejarla en paz."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Find Paesyn and talk to him.
[ES] Encuentra a Paesyn y habla con él.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "All right.... I'll do what I can."
[ES] "Muy bien... Haré lo que pueda."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Hot Springs Creature Meat
[ES] Carne de criatura de aguas termales
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Hot Springs Starfish and Hot Springs Kamara to get their meat.
[ES] Mata estrellas de mar de aguas termales y kamaras de aguas termales para conseguir su carne.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Hot Springs Creature Meat to Paesyn.
[ES] Llévale la carne de criatura de aguas termales a Paesyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I hope it works...for your sake."
[ES] "Espero que funcione... por tu bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sigh...fine. Let's get it over with."
[ES] "Suspiro... Bueno. Acabemos con esto."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Ask Paesyn if he's ready to return.
[ES] Pregúntale a Paesyn si está listo para regresar.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Um...I need to report to Renish..."
[ES] "Mmm... Tengo que informarle a Renish..."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the tonic to Zolyn.
[ES] Entrégale el tónico a Zolyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring the restored pendant to Renish at Amadjuak Trading Post.
[ES] Llévale el colgante restaurado a Renish en Amadjuak Trading Post.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
